title: SP Half Marathon 2026 Review: Sungai Petani's Kedah 21K
seo_title: SP Half Marathon 2026 Review | Kedah Malaysia Race
meta_description: SP Half Marathon 2026: September 26 at Dataran Sungai Petani, Kedah. A single-distance 21.1K from Generasi Athletic Club — registration open.
dek: Set for 26 September 2026 at Dataran Sungai Petani in Kedah, this Generasi Athletic Club production is a single-distance 21.1K with registration open.
verdict: The SP Half Marathon is a focused, single-distance 21.1K in Sungai Petani — Kedah's second-largest town, roughly 30 minutes from the Thai border. Organised by Generasi Athletic Club at Dataran Sungai Petani, a central town square with good event infrastructure. Registration is open. A straightforward northern Malaysian half marathon for runners wanting a focused, single-distance event off the major-city circuit.
